description_en: Queries all device certificates that are issued by a certificate authority (CA) certificate and registered with ApsaraMQ for MQTT brokers. Device certificates are digital certificates issued to clients by CA root certificates. When you connect an ApsaraMQ for MQTT client to an ApsaraMQ for MQTT broker, the broker uses the device certificate to authenticate the client. If the client passes the authentication, the client and the broker can communicate with each other based on the encrypted private key in the device certificate. If the client fails the authentication, access requests from the client are denied by the client
description_zh:
设备证书是由CA根证书签发给客户端设备使用的数字证书，用于客户端和服务端连接时，服务端对客户端进行安全认证。认证通过后服务端和客户端可基于证书内的加密密钥进行安全通信，若认证不通过则服务端拒绝客户端接入。
本接口用于查询由指定CA证书签发且已在微消息队列MQTT版服务端注册的所有设备证书
name: ListDeviceCertificateByCaSn

parameters.help_en: The instance ID bound to the CA certificate, which is the instance ID of the MQTT version of the cloud message queue
parameters.help_zh: CA证书所绑定的实例ID，即云消息队列 MQTT 版的实例ID
parameters.name: mqtt_instance_id

parameters.help_en: Indicates the page number of the returned results. The starting page is counted from 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页的返回结果。起始页从第1页开始计算
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of query records to display per page. Value range: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页最多显示几条查询记录。

取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The SN serial number of the CA certificate to be queried, indicating which CA certificate's registered device certificates are to be retrieved
parameters.help_zh: 待查询CA证书的SN序列码，表示查询哪一个CA证书下所有已注册的设备证书
parameters.name: ca_sn

CaSn.description_en: The SN serial number of the CA certificate to which the device certificate belongs, used to uniquely identify a CA certificate
CaSn.description_zh: 设备证书所属的CA证书的SN序列号，用于唯一标识一个CA证书

DeviceContent.description_en:
Content of the device certificate.

 represents a new line
DeviceContent.description_zh:
设备证书的内容。

\n表示换行

DeviceSn.description_en: The SN serial number of the device certificate, used to uniquely identify a device certificate
DeviceSn.description_zh: 设备证书的SN序列号，用于唯一标识一个设备证书

Status.description_en:
The status of the device certificate. The values are as follows:
0: indicates that the certificate is in an inactive state. 
1: indicates that the certificate is in an active state.

After the device certificate is registered, it is in an active state by default
Status.description_zh:
设备证书的状态。取值如下：

0：表示证书为未激活状态。

1：表示证书为激活状态。

设备证书注册后，默认为激活状态

ValidBegin.description_en: The start time when the device certificate becomes effective. The format is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
ValidBegin.description_zh: 设备证书生效的起始时间。格式为毫秒级别的Unix时间戳

ValidEnd.description_en: The end time when the device certificate becomes effective. The format is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
ValidEnd.description_zh: 设备证书生效的终止时间。格式为毫秒级别的Unix时间戳

PageNo.description_en: The current page number of the returned query records
PageNo.description_zh: 当前返回的查询记录是第几页

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of results to display per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的最大结果数

RequestId.description_en: Public parameters, each request ID is unique and can be used for troubleshooting and problem localization
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
